title: What's new in Sustainability: EUDR Certificate Capture (2026 release wave 2)

features.name: EUDR item marking on item card
features.description: Dedicated fields on the item card sustainability tab to mark items as EUDR relevant and assign commodity classification.

features.name: Lot number certificate information capture
features.description: Certificate details captured on the lot number information card, including certificate number, certification schema, dates, and country of origin.
caveats: DDS numbers must be entered manually

features.name: EUTR flag on purchase lines
features.description: EUTR flag added at line level on purchase orders and receipts to identify lines related to EUTR for supply chain purposes.

features.name: Certification information on sales invoices
features.description: Ability to display certification details on sales invoice layout, showing lot number, certification schema, and certification number to customers.

quotes.text: it's like people talking everywhere about this EUDR, which is EU Deforestation Regulation. It's starting to be mandatory
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes the regulatory driver and timing for EUDR feature development.

quotes.text: when you're getting to the EU market your items, where it was produced and that it has a certification
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the core business requirement the feature addresses - tracking production origin and certification for EU market access.

quotes.text: that is why we are going to use the item tracking for that functionality
quotes.why_it_matters: Design decision to leverage existing item tracking infrastructure for EUDR batch-level tracking.

quotes.text: We don't have the integration with Traces. So the DDS numbers you will need to type in manually
quotes.why_it_matters: Key limitation stating that Traces integration is not included in the current release.

quotes.text: same for the geolocation. But, we are continue to work on that functionality
quotes.why_it_matters: Indicates geolocation is planned as future work but not currently automated.

disclaimers.text: We don't have the integration with Traces. So the DDS numbers you will need to type in manually
same for the geolocation. But, we are continue to work on that functionality
